title: Capitalize the Title
summary: Given a string title with words separated by a space, transform each word by converting the first letter to uppercase and the rest to lowercase if the word length is greater than two.
statement: Given a string title with words separated by a space, transform each word by converting the first letter to uppercase and the rest to lowercase if the word length is greater than two. For words of one or two letters, convert all to lowercase.
constraints: title has words separated by single spaces.
Words of length one or two become lowercase; longer words get an uppercase first letter and lowercase remainder.
Preserve word order and single separators.
hints: Normalize case before applying the length-based first-letter rule.
Split on spaces; lowercase each word; capitalize only when its length exceeds two.
Append lowered if len<=2 else lowered.capitalize(), then join with spaces.
Each word is transformed independently according to exactly one rule, while split/join preserves order and separators.
